overall_goal: Boil the potatoes until they are soft.

goals.description: Fill the saucepan with hot water and set it on the hob to boil.
goals.rationale: The person fills the saucepan with hot water, places it on the hob, and turns on the heat to start boiling the potatoes.

goals.description: Retrieve a wooden spoon and stir the boiling potatoes.
goals.rationale: The person gets a wooden spoon from a drawer, closes the drawer, and uses the spoon to stir the potatoes so they cook evenly.

goals.description: Stir the potatoes and check if they are fully cooked.
goals.rationale: The person stirs the potatoes and presses down on chunks to check their softness and determine if they are ready.
